editorial.description_en: Rock in the tidal zone: a mid grey with the sea in it, cool and very low in chroma.
editorial.description_ja: 潮のとどく岩のような、青みのある灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.686, C 0.030, h 190.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 潮 (shio, tide) + 岩 (iwa, rock). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Tide Rock" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 潮岩. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — sawa-ishi at ΔE00 6.7, sugi-kage at ΔE00 8.6, kawa-goke at ΔE00 9.9. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.030 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
